The HECC compressor has a design speed of 21,789 rpm.
The impeller exit speed of the HECC compressor is 1615 ft/s.
The HECC impeller has 15 main-blade/splitter-blade pairs.
The spanwise varying backsweep of the HECC impeller blades is between 32° to 42° from radial.
The vaned diffuser has 20 main/splitter vane pairs.
The EGV has 60 cascade style airfoils.
The compressor was tested at the NASA Glenn Research Center.
The mass flow rate was measured using an orifice.
The uncertainty of the orifice-based mass flow measurement system is ± 0.1 lb/s.
The compressor operating speeds are based on once-per-rev measurements acquired at the compressor shaft.
The compressor speeds are corrected to standard day conditions based on temperature measurements taken in the plenum tank.
The flow path pressures are collected using a scanning pressure measurement system with an uncertainty of ± 0.07 percent of the transducers full scale.
The temperature measurements are referenced to an isothermal reference block with an estimated uncertainty of ± 2.3 R for inlet conditions.
The data system scans all measurement channels at a sampling rate of 1 Hz.
The data reported in this paper are averages of 20 consecutive scans.
The rig is verified to have reached thermal equilibrium based on tip-clearance measurements that remain constant over a 15 min time period.
